_note: pip install minihack (needs setuptools<81). Eating floor food is a TWO-step NetHack action: press E, then NetHack asks 'eat it? [ynq]' and you answer Y (yes). That confirm keystroke is why eating seems to 'freeze' after E -- you must then press Y. (NetHack draws the prompt on the tty message line, which is NOT part of the pixel observation, so it can't be shown on screen; the E-then-Y recipe in the instructions is what the player follows.) In NetHack y/n ARE the NW/SE movement keys, so the diagonal keys double as the yes/no answers (Y=act 7='y', N=act 5='n'). Egocentric view: MiniHack's own pixel_crop, a 9x9 window centred on the agent, so the agent holds still and the level slides; eat.json plays the same task with the view fixed on the level's map.
